decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film 'Imitation of Life'. The source documents identify two distinct films with this title: a 1934 version directed by John M. Stahl (D1S1, D2S3-D2S4) and a 1959 remake directed by Douglas Sirk (D1S6, D2S1). Since both are valid directors of a film titled 'Imitation of Life', both names are included as complementary answers.
